note: All runs before the final 2026-08-18 capture lack the final 96-inch counterpoise and are retained only as configuration history.

calibration_runs.purpose: Final full-span OSL calibration and reconnect verification.

antenna_runs.configuration: Initial approximate inverted V; apex about 8 ft; far end low.
antenna_runs.effect: Established the initial 6.304 MHz resonance at SWR 1.52, below 40m.

antenna_runs.configuration: Same 8 ft inverted V; three-pass focused repeat.
antenna_runs.effect: Confirmed the baseline within 0.4 kHz and 0.001 SWR.

antenna_runs.configuration: Same 8 ft inverted V; middle of 12 ft coax rerouted.
antenna_runs.effect: Shifted resonance down 2.6 kHz and SWR down 0.009; small but measurable feed-line sensitivity.

antenna_runs.configuration: 8 ft inverted V; 22 in total removed.
antenna_runs.effect: Moved resonance up 158 kHz to 6.460 MHz; minimum SWR rose to 1.59.

antenna_runs.configuration: 8 ft inverted V; 52 in total removed.
antenna_runs.effect: Moved resonance up another 254 kHz to 6.714 MHz; minimum SWR improved to 1.51.

antenna_runs.configuration: 8 ft inverted V; 60 in total removed.
antenna_runs.effect: Moved resonance up another 99 kHz to 6.812 MHz; minimum SWR improved to 1.48.

antenna_runs.configuration: 25 ft to 3 ft sloper; 8 in feed loop; 12 ft coax; no choke or counterpoise.
antenna_runs.change: Raised far end to about 25 ft and changed coax route.
antenna_runs.effect: Moved resonance into 40m at 7.025 MHz and improved minimum SWR to 1.38.

antenna_runs.configuration: 25 ft to 3 ft sloper; 8 in feed loop; 12 ft coax; no choke or counterpoise.
antenna_runs.change: Three-pass focused repeat of the raised sloper.
antenna_runs.effect: Confirmed the raised-sloper result within 0.4 kHz and 0.001 SWR.

antenna_runs.configuration: 25 ft to 3 ft sloper; 8 in feed loop; 14 in far loop; no choke or counterpoise.
antenna_runs.change: Set permanent 14 in far-end tie-off loop.
antenna_runs.effect: Shifted resonance down 4.6 kHz and raised minimum SWR by 0.019.

antenna_runs.configuration: Same sloper and loops; no choke or counterpoise.
antenna_runs.effect: Measured minima of 1.40 on 40m, 2.23 on 20m, 4.59 on 15m, and 1.81 on 10m.

antenna_runs.configuration: Final 62.5 ft wire, 8 in feed loop, 14 in far loop, 25 ft to 3 ft sloper, 96 in grounded counterpoise, no choke.
antenna_runs.change: Added the final 96 in counterpoise and repeated full OSL-calibrated span.
antenna_runs.effect: Kept 40m essentially unchanged at 1.41, improved 15m from 4.59 to 1.89 and 10m from 1.81 to 1.68, while 20m changed from 2.23 to 2.58.
